purpose: Provide a default-off, fail-closed source-inclusive-forward IMU scheduling lane for the Pixel5 Phase171 ECEF-D GNSS-first to Pose3/IMU main handoff, while preserving the legacy native schedule and all other model choices.

implementation.behavior: The opt-in main-graph branch validates the mapped native IMU stream once, selects samples with an exact finite offset in the inclusive [t0,t1] interval, integrates each selected sample forward to its next stream timestamp, and repeats the final stream delta only for a selected final stream sample. It uses an overlap cursor for adjacent GNSS intervals and never clips to a GNSS boundary or creates a synthetic tail.
preserved: legacy preceding-delta plus boundary-tail loop when selector is false
IMU initialization and bias random walk
IMU measurement/integration noise and Phase194 selector
GNSS-first P/TDCP/C7/D handoff and one ECEF-to-ENU conversion
implementation.time_basis: The helper consumes already mapped native timestamps. UTC/GPS affine mapping and its small slope distinction remain in the caller; no fixed offset is substituted by this schedule branch.
fail_closed: non-positive or non-finite stream/selected forward deltas
non-finite selected accelerometer or gyro samples

reported: integrated and GNSS interval duration min/max
diagnostics.default_off_shape: The legacy branch leaves Phase201 counters at their initialized zero/NaN values and does not execute the helper.

source_evidence.scope_note: This implements the audited schedule as a separate native experiment; it does not claim full MATLAB factor/noise parity or physical correctness. Phase200 showed that the inclusive-forward convention can over- or under-integrate a bounded GNSS interval depending on sample placement.

python_contract_tests.scope: Source-contract checks; runtime CLI composition was separately probed to the input-open boundary without raw payloads.

verification.production_fixture_scope: The synthetic Phase171 fixture uses index-derived IMU times and asserts one interval, 11 selected samples, 1.1 s source duration, and 0.1 s duration error for the opt-in branch. It is not a real H run.

limitations: No raw GNSS/IMU/nav execution, candidate/truth read, MAT/PDC/precomputed trajectory read, accuracy evaluation, or Kaggle submission was performed in Phase201.
The production branch uses native CombinedImuFactor; the cached source's ImuFactor keying and other factor/noise semantics remain separate concerns.
The synthetic and source-contract tests do not establish real-data accuracy or prove that the source-inclusive schedule is physically preferable.
The mapped timestamp stream is assumed to have been validated by the existing UTC/GPS loader; this phase does not change UTC fallback, pairing, or offset behavior.
